name: Menus
description: Storefront menus: named menus of links, shop pages, headings and categories that open into their subcategories (only those with something to buy, if you like). A menu is placed anywhere with the Menu block and drawn as a row, a drop-down, a list or columns.

settings.label: Keep category counts for, minutes
settings.help: How long the number of products behind a menu's categories (and the "only with products in stock" rule) is reused before being counted again. 0 — count on every page.
